_comment: collect_mode=queue: 1 section per acted tick, written immediately via BACKGROUND writer thread (sync write measured 57ms on game volume = stutter source). Heavy sections are TIME-SLICED: iter_sonar_arrays (~216ms) is pumped max section_slice_ms per tick until done. min_tick_interval=0.2: acted ticks ~2.9/s so slices resume fast; per-tick cost is bounded by the slice budget, not the throttle. measure_perf=true: tick block times + section costs in ship_state.json 'perf' (currently ON: performance/tick timing instrumentation re-enabled 2026-08-30). collect_mode=bulk restores legacy full collect_state() every state_every ticks.
